title: Mother of PC Harper ‘bitterly disappointed’ that son’s killers remain eligible for early release – UK politics live
summary_full: Government revises plans to tackle prison overcrowding amid pressure from MPs and victims but domestic abusers and killers could still be released earlySome 86,495 people were in prison in England and Wales as of 3 August, according to the latest data published by the Ministry of Justice.This is 2,026 below the record high of 88,521 reached on 6 September 2024, just before the current early release scheme began.
